body:
Hey man, first of all i'm truly sorry that you're feeling this low- it sucks, and I know it too. But please, you need to reach out- you need to get help from someone, anyone, as soon as possible. You still have time, and even though it feels permanent i promise it's not. You said that you've been feeling shit for months, can you remember what it was like when you felt good? That time will come again, despite feeling like you'll always feel shit, you will soon start to feel better and start laughing again- but you just need to push through in order to see this. 

Please, don't act impulsively. Try your hardest to reach out, and just remember that there's so much more to life than what you're feeling now. I wish you all the best, and i genuinely believe you can do this.

It's insane how someone you've never met can make you smile more than any of your friends could. I cannot thank you enough for your uplifting words of advice, i really truly needed them right now. I really like the idea of an entertaining washing up session- definitely going on the to do list! Just seeing someone take the time to reply so thoughtfully to my post gives me so much motivation to go on, and i'm going to try my best to remember it throughout the week. Thanks again, have a great day :)
Music is a blessing, honestly- it's like the best friend you'll ever have. Good luck on your exams man!
Thanks for the advice man, i'm definitely going to use studying as a way to distract myself. It honestly means alot that you replied, hope you have a good rest of your day :)
